title: 眼科
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋急性隅角閉鎖性青光眼與化學灼傷等眼科急症、紅眼分流、白內障超音波乳化手術、糖尿病視網膜病變篩檢與雷射／抗 VEGF、黃斑部病變、視網膜剝離、慢性青光眼藥物與小樑切除、角膜潰瘍、葡萄膜炎、斜視與弱視、早產兒視網膜病變、開放性眼球外傷、巨細胞動脈炎與視神經炎、屈光手術、眼瞼手術、視野與 OCT 判讀。
introEn: This library covers acute angle-closure glaucoma and chemical burns and other eye emergencies, red-eye triage, phacoemulsification cataract surgery, diabetic retinopathy screening with laser and anti-VEGF, macular degeneration, retinal detachment, chronic glaucoma drugs and trabeculectomy, corneal ulcer, uveitis, strabismus and amblyopia, retinopathy of prematurity, open-globe trauma, giant cell arteritis and optic neuritis, refractive surgery, eyelid surgery, visual-field and OCT interpretation.

procedures.title: 紅眼分流與結膜炎鑑別
procedures.titleEn: Red eye triage and conjunctivitis differentiation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：急診候診區同時有四位紅眼病人：28 歲雙眼黏稠分泌物、45 歲單眼劇痛畏光、62 歲單眼視力模糊伴噁心、8 歲雙眼癢流淚。本單元教以視力、疼痛、瞳孔與分泌物分流危險紅眼，並區分結膜炎類型；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: four red eyes in the waiting room at once: a 28-year-old with sticky bilateral discharge, a 45-year-old with severe unilateral pain and photophobia, a 62-year-old with blurred vision and nausea in one eye, and an 8-year-old with itchy watery eyes. Teaches triage of the dangerous red eye by vision, pain, pupil and discharge, and conjunctivitis typing. Education, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 分流四問
stages.evidence: 分流護理師問你該先問什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: The triage nurse asks what to ask first.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 視力、疼痛、畏光與戴鏡史
choices.en: Vision, pain, photophobia and lens wear

choices.zh: 先問分泌物的顏色與有無發癢
choices.en: Discharge colour and itch first

choices.zh: 只需問紅了多久以及單雙側
choices.en: Just duration and whether one or both eyes

stages.reason: 視力下降、真正疼痛（非異物感）、畏光與隱形眼鏡是紅眼的四大危險訊號。
stages.reasonEn: Reduced vision, true pain rather than grittiness, photophobia and contact lens wear are the four danger signals of a red eye.
stages.pitfall: 若只問時間：角膜潰瘍排在結膜炎後面。
stages.pitfallEn: Asking only about duration seats a corneal ulcer behind the conjunctivitis.

stages.title: 視力
stages.evidence: 62 歲病人：右眼 Snellen 6/60（logMAR 1.0），左眼 6/6；28 歲雙眼 6/6。
stages.evidenceEn: The 62-year-old: right 6/60 (logMAR 1.0), left 6/6; the 28-year-old 6/6 both eyes.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 兩人同樣緊急，依掛號順序
choices.en: Equally urgent; see them in order of arrival

choices.zh: 視力正常者就不需裂隙燈
choices.en: Normal vision needs no slit lamp

choices.zh: 單眼視力驟降是最高優先
choices.en: A one-eye acuity drop is top priority

stages.reason: 每位紅眼病人都要測視力（針孔矯正）；視力是分流的生命徵象。
stages.reasonEn: Every red eye gets an acuity (with pinhole); vision is the vital sign of triage.
stages.pitfall: 若未測視力：急性青光眼坐著等了三小時。
stages.pitfallEn: Vision unmeasured, acute glaucoma waits three hours.

stages.title: 瞳孔
stages.evidence: 62 歲：右瞳孔中度散大、固定、角膜霧；45 歲：右瞳孔小、對光遲緩。
stages.evidenceEn: The 62-year-old: right pupil mid-dilated, fixed, hazy cornea; the 45-year-old: small sluggish right pupil.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 紅眼時瞳孔沒有鑑別意義
choices.en: Pupils don't discriminate in red eye

choices.zh: 前者疑閉鎖，後者疑虹彩炎
choices.en: First suggests angle closure, second iritis

choices.zh: 兩人都是結膜炎的瞳孔反應
choices.en: Both are conjunctivitis pupil responses

stages.reason: 瞳孔是紅眼的方向盤：結膜炎瞳孔正常；虹彩炎縮小；隅角閉鎖中度散大固定。
stages.reasonEn: The pupil steers the red eye: normal in conjunctivitis, small in iritis, mid-dilated and fixed in angle closure.
stages.pitfall: 若不看瞳孔：三種病看起來都是紅眼。
stages.pitfallEn: Without the pupil, three diseases look alike.

stages.title: 分泌物
stages.evidence: 28 歲：早上眼皮黏住、黏膿分泌物、無癢；8 歲：水樣分泌物、劇癢、結膜乳突。
stages.evidenceEn: The 28-year-old: lids glued in the morning, mucopurulent discharge, no itch; the 8-year-old: watery, intensely itchy, papillae.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 前者偏細菌性，後者偏過敏
choices.en: First bacterial, second allergic

choices.zh: 兩人都應該開立抗生素眼藥水
choices.en: Both should get antibiotic drops

choices.zh: 兩者都是病毒性結膜炎
choices.en: Both are viral conjunctivitis

stages.reason: 癢是過敏的特徵；黏膿分泌物偏細菌；水樣分泌物加耳前淋巴結偏病毒。
stages.reasonEn: Itch is the hallmark of allergy; mucopurulent discharge favours bacteria; watery discharge with a preauricular node favours virus.
stages.pitfall: 若對過敏兒開抗生素：癢沒好，又多了副作用。
stages.pitfallEn: Antibiotics for the allergic child leave the itch and add side-effects.

stages.title: 角膜染色
stages.evidence: 45 歲病人螢光染色：角膜無缺損；另一位隱形眼鏡配戴者：中央 2 mm 白色浸潤伴上皮缺損。
stages.evidenceEn: The 45-year-old stains negative; a contact lens wearer shows a 2 mm central white infiltrate with an epithelial defect.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 兩人都可先回家，明天再看門診
choices.en: Both home; clinic tomorrow

choices.zh: 戴鏡者只是鏡片相關的結膜炎
choices.en: The lens wearer has lens-related conjunctivitis

choices.zh: 角膜潰瘍：今天就轉眼科
choices.en: Corneal ulcer: ophthalmology today

stages.reason: 螢光染色在幾秒內分辨上皮缺損；白色浸潤代表基質感染，是數小時內的急症。
stages.reasonEn: Fluorescein separates an epithelial defect in seconds; a white infiltrate means stromal infection and is an emergency measured in hours.
stages.pitfall: 若無染色：潰瘍被當結膜炎給了類固醇。
stages.pitfallEn: Unstained, an ulcer gets steroids as conjunctivitis.

stages.title: 眼壓
stages.evidence: 62 歲：右眼壓 52 mmHg，左 16；前房淺。
stages.evidenceEn: The 62-year-old: right IOP 52 mmHg, left 16; shallow chamber.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 嚴重結膜炎合併角膜水腫
choices.en: Severe conjunctivitis with corneal oedema

choices.zh: 急性隅角閉鎖：立即處置
choices.en: Acute angle closure: treat now

choices.zh: 單次測量誤差，明天再測
choices.en: A measurement error; recheck tomorrow

stages.reason: 眼壓驟升伴視力下降、噁心與角膜水腫是視神經的倒數計時。
stages.reasonEn: A surge in pressure with vision loss, nausea and corneal oedema is a countdown for the optic nerve.
stages.pitfall: 若未測眼壓：病人被當腸胃炎送回家。
stages.pitfallEn: Pressure unmeasured, she is sent home with gastroenteritis.

stages.title: 危險紅眼
stages.evidence: 45 歲：睫狀充血、前房細胞與閃光、小瞳孔、畏光。
stages.evidenceEn: The 45-year-old: ciliary flush, cells and flare, small pupil, photophobia.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 急性前葡萄膜炎：今日轉眼科
choices.en: Acute anterior uveitis: ophthalmology today

choices.zh: 嚴重乾眼症，給人工淚液即可
choices.en: Severe dry eye: artificial tears

choices.zh: 病毒性結膜炎，冰敷即可
choices.en: Viral conjunctivitis: cold compresses

stages.reason: 睫狀充血（角膜周圍）而非瀰漫充血，加上前房反應，指向眼內發炎。
stages.reasonEn: Ciliary (limbal) flush rather than diffuse redness, plus anterior chamber reaction, points to intraocular inflammation.
stages.pitfall: 若給抗生素眼藥水：虹彩沾黏與青光眼。
stages.pitfallEn: Antibiotic drops leave synechiae and glaucoma.

stages.title: 結膜炎分型
stages.evidence: 另一位 35 歲：單眼水樣分泌物、耳前淋巴結、一週後另一眼也紅、角膜上皮下浸潤。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient, 35: watery unilateral discharge, preauricular node, the other eye red a week later, subepithelial infiltrates.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 季節性過敏性結膜炎急性發作
choices.en: An acute flare of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis

choices.zh: 細菌性結膜炎，需抗生素
choices.en: Bacterial conjunctivitis needing antibiotics

choices.zh: 腺病毒角結膜炎，傳染性高
choices.en: Adenoviral keratoconjunctivitis, highly contagious

stages.reason: 耳前淋巴結、先後雙眼與角膜上皮下浸潤是腺病毒的特徵；抗生素無效。
stages.reasonEn: A preauricular node, sequential bilateral involvement and subepithelial infiltrates mark adenovirus; antibiotics do not help.
stages.pitfall: 若未隔離：整個候診室被傳染。
stages.pitfallEn: Unisolated, the whole waiting room catches it.

stages.title: 處置與感染控制
stages.evidence: 腺病毒病人剛用過候診區的門把與你的裂隙燈。
stages.evidenceEn: The adenovirus patient has just touched the door handle and your slit lamp.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 一般擦拭即可，不需特別處理
choices.en: A routine wipe; nothing special

choices.zh: 手部衛生、消毒裂隙燈與隔離衛教
choices.en: Hand hygiene, disinfect the slit lamp, isolation advice

choices.zh: 所有候診病人都給予預防性抗生素
choices.en: Prophylactic antibiotics for everyone waiting

stages.reason: 腺病毒在表面可存活數週；門診爆發多來自器械。細菌性結膜炎多自限，抗生素僅略縮短病程。
stages.reasonEn: Adenovirus survives weeks on surfaces; clinic outbreaks come from instruments. Bacterial conjunctivitis is mostly self-limiting; antibiotics shorten it only slightly.
stages.pitfall: 若不消毒：下週你的門診成為感染源。
stages.pitfallEn: Undisinfected, your clinic becomes next week's source.

stages.title: 轉診與交班
stages.evidence: 四位病人的去向。
stages.evidenceEn: Where the four patients go.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 閉鎖立即、潰瘍葡萄膜炎今日
choices.en: Closure now; ulcer and uveitis today; conjunctivitis to GP

choices.zh: 全部先回家，明天再排眼科門診
choices.en: Everyone home; eye clinic tomorrow

choices.zh: 四位全部立即轉眼科急診
choices.en: All four to eye casualty now

stages.reason: 分流的目的是把急症送上快車道，並讓自限疾病不佔用急診。
stages.reasonEn: Triage puts emergencies on the fast track and keeps self-limiting disease out of the emergency department.
stages.pitfall: 若全部轉診：急症排在結膜炎後面。
stages.pitfallEn: Referring everyone queues the emergency behind the conjunctivitis.

stages.title: 新生兒的例外
stages.evidence: 產後第 5 天新生兒：雙眼大量膿性分泌物、眼瞼腫脹。
stages.evidenceEn: A 5-day-old neonate: profuse purulent discharge, swollen lids.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 給抗生素眼藥水點一週就好了
choices.en: A week of antibiotic drops will do

choices.zh: 先天鼻淚管阻塞，按摩觀察
choices.en: Blocked tear duct: massage and observe

choices.zh: 新生兒眼炎：培養並全身治療
choices.en: Ophthalmia neonatorum: culture and systemic treatment

stages.reason: 淋病雙球菌可在 24 小時內穿孔角膜；新生兒結膜炎是全身性疾病的眼部表現。
stages.reasonEn: Gonococcus can perforate the cornea within 24 hours; neonatal conjunctivitis is the ocular face of systemic disease.
stages.pitfall: 若只給眼藥水：角膜穿孔與肺炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Drops alone end in perforation and pneumonia.

procedures.title: 急性隅角閉鎖性青光眼
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：64 歲遠視女性，看完電影後右眼劇痛、視力模糊、看燈有彩虹光暈、嘔吐兩次；急診原以為偏頭痛。本單元教辨識、眼壓下降的原則、雷射虹膜切開的概念與對側眼預防，不含藥物劑量與雷射參數；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 64-year-old hyperopic woman with severe right eye pain after a cinema visit, blurred vision, haloes around lights and two vomits; the ED suspected migraine. Teaches recognition, the principles of lowering pressure, the concept of laser iridotomy and protection of the fellow eye; no doses or laser settings. Education, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 誘因
stages.evidence: 遠視、黑暗環境、年長女性、晚上發作。
stages.evidenceEn: Hyperopia, a dark environment, older woman, evening onset.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 典型偏頭痛的誘發型態
choices.en: A typical migraine trigger pattern

choices.zh: 隅角閉鎖的高風險組合
choices.en: A high-risk combination for angle closure

choices.zh: 腸胃炎引起的頭痛嘔吐
choices.en: Headache and vomiting from gastroenteritis

stages.reason: 遠視眼前房淺；黑暗讓瞳孔中度散大，虹膜堵住小樑網；亞洲女性風險更高。
stages.reasonEn: Hyperopic eyes have shallow chambers; darkness mid-dilates the pupil and the iris blocks the trabecular meshwork; Asian women carry higher risk.
stages.pitfall: 若當偏頭痛：等到視神經受損。
stages.pitfallEn: Called migraine, the optic nerve pays.

stages.title: 視力與瞳孔
stages.evidence: 右眼視力數指，瞳孔中度散大、對光無反應、角膜霧狀。
stages.evidenceEn: Right eye counting fingers, mid-dilated unreactive pupil, hazy cornea.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 高眼壓所致的典型三聯徵
choices.en: The classic triad of high pressure

choices.zh: 老年性白內障的正常表現
choices.en: Normal for an old cataract

choices.zh: 瞳孔固定代表顱內病變
choices.en: A fixed pupil means an intracranial lesion

stages.reason: 角膜水腫（霧）、中度散大固定瞳孔與硬如石頭的眼球是床邊診斷的三要素。
stages.reasonEn: Corneal oedema, a mid-dilated fixed pupil and a rock-hard globe are the three bedside elements.
stages.pitfall: 若送神經科：CT 正常，眼睛更糟。
stages.pitfallEn: Sent to neurology, the CT is normal and the eye is worse.

stages.title: 眼壓
stages.evidence: 右眼壓 58 mmHg，左 15；右前房極淺、對側亦淺。
stages.evidenceEn: Right IOP 58 mmHg, left 15; very shallow right chamber, the left also shallow.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 先做頭部 CT 排除顱內病變
choices.en: Head CT first to exclude intracranial pathology

choices.zh: 測量誤差，重測一次再說
choices.en: Probably a measurement error; repeat it

choices.zh: 急性隅角閉鎖，立即開始降壓
choices.en: Acute angle closure: lower pressure now

stages.reason: 正常眼壓 10–21 mmHg；>40 伴症狀即為急症。對側淺前房提示將來同樣發作。
stages.reasonEn: Normal IOP is 10-21 mmHg; above 40 with symptoms is an emergency. A shallow fellow chamber predicts the same attack.
stages.pitfall: 若延遲：數小時內永久視野缺損。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay costs permanent field within hours.

stages.title: 隅角鏡
stages.evidence: 角膜清晰後隅角鏡：右眼全周無隅角結構（Shaffer 0）；左眼僅見 Schwalbe 線（Shaffer 1）。
stages.evidenceEn: Once the cornea clears: right eye shows no angle structures all round (Shaffer 0); left shows only Schwalbe's line (Shaffer 1).
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 兩眼隅角皆屬開放，不需要處理
choices.en: Both angles are open; no action

choices.zh: 右眼閉鎖、左眼窄角，皆需處理
choices.en: Right closed, left occludable: treat both

choices.zh: 眼壓已知，隅角鏡不必要
choices.en: We know the pressure; gonioscopy is unnecessary

stages.reason: Shaffer 0 閉鎖、1 極窄、2 窄、3–4 開放；隅角鏡是確認機制與評估對側眼的標準。
stages.reasonEn: Shaffer 0 is closed, 1 extremely narrow, 2 narrow, 3-4 open; gonioscopy confirms the mechanism and assesses the fellow eye.
stages.pitfall: 若不做：對側眼在一年內同樣發作。
stages.pitfallEn: Skipped, the fellow eye attacks within a year.

stages.title: 診斷
stages.evidence: 整合：症狀、眼壓 58、閉鎖隅角、瞳孔阻滯機制。
stages.evidenceEn: Putting it together: symptoms, IOP 58, closed angle, pupil-block mechanism.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 原發性急性隅角閉鎖
choices.en: Primary acute angle closure

choices.zh: 急性發作的開放隅角青光眼
choices.en: Acute flare of open-angle glaucoma

choices.zh: 糖尿病新生血管性青光眼
choices.en: Diabetic neovascular glaucoma

stages.reason: 需排除次發性原因（水晶體膨脹、新生血管、葡萄膜炎）；原發性瞳孔阻滯是最常見且雷射可治。
stages.reasonEn: Secondary causes (phacomorphic, neovascular, uveitic) are excluded; primary pupil block is commonest and laser-treatable.
stages.pitfall: 若誤為開放隅角：縮瞳與虹膜切開被延誤。
stages.pitfallEn: Mistaken for open angle, miosis and iridotomy are delayed.

stages.title: 降壓原則
stages.evidence: 住院醫師問用什麼順序。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident asks about the order.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 給止痛止吐即可，眼壓自然會降
choices.en: Analgesia and antiemetic; pressure will fall

choices.zh: 立即雷射虹膜切開降壓最快
choices.en: Immediate laser iridotomy is fastest

choices.zh: 先藥物降壓，角膜清晰再雷射
choices.en: Lower pressure medically; laser once the cornea clears

stages.reason: 角膜水腫時雷射無法穿透；藥物先降壓、縮瞳拉開隅角。禁忌（腎、心、鐮刀型）需確認。
stages.reasonEn: Laser cannot pass a cloudy cornea; drugs lower pressure first and miosis pulls the angle open. Contraindications (renal, cardiac, sickle cell) are checked.
stages.pitfall: 若直接雷射：穿不透水腫角膜。
stages.pitfallEn: Immediate laser fails to penetrate the oedematous cornea.

stages.title: 再評估
stages.evidence: 1 小時後：眼壓 42；2 小時後 30；角膜漸清、瞳孔縮小。
stages.evidenceEn: One hour: IOP 42; two hours: 30; cornea clearing, pupil smaller.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 眼壓已在下降，可先回家
choices.en: Pressure is falling; go home

choices.zh: 有反應：持續監測再安排雷射
choices.en: Responding: keep monitoring, then laser

choices.zh: 仍高於 21，立即小樑切除
choices.en: Still above 21: trabeculectomy now

stages.reason: 每小時再測眼壓；藥物無反應者考慮雷射虹膜成形或前房穿刺。
stages.reasonEn: Pressure is rechecked hourly; non-responders go to laser iridoplasty or paracentesis.
stages.pitfall: 若過早放行：半夜眼壓反彈。
stages.pitfallEn: Discharged early, pressure rebounds overnight.

stages.title: 雷射虹膜切開
stages.evidence: 角膜清晰、眼壓 18；準備雷射。
stages.evidenceEn: Cornea clear, IOP 18; ready for laser.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 雙眼周邊虹膜切開，對側預防
choices.en: Peripheral iridotomy to both eyes

choices.zh: 眼壓已經正常，不需要再雷射
choices.en: Pressure is normal; no laser needed

choices.zh: 只做發作眼，對側觀察即可
choices.en: Treat the affected eye; watch the other

stages.reason: 虹膜切開讓房水繞過瞳孔；對側眼未治療者約半數在 5 年內發作。
stages.reasonEn: Iridotomy lets aqueous bypass the pupil; roughly half of untreated fellow eyes attack within five years.
stages.pitfall: 若只做一眼：另一眼下次在旅途中發作。
stages.pitfallEn: One eye only, the other attacks on holiday.

stages.title: 後續
stages.evidence: 雷射後 1 週：眼壓 24，隅角鏡示部分周邊前黏連。
stages.evidenceEn: A week after laser: IOP 24, gonioscopy shows some peripheral anterior synechiae.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 再補做一次虹膜切開就能完全解決
choices.en: Another iridotomy will fix it

choices.zh: 已經做過雷射，可以結案了
choices.en: The laser is done, so discharge

choices.zh: 需長期降壓藥，可考慮摘水晶體
choices.en: Long-term drops; consider lens extraction

stages.reason: 長時間閉鎖造成永久黏連與小樑損傷；EAGLE 試驗支持清透水晶體摘除作為選項。
stages.reasonEn: Prolonged closure leaves permanent synechiae and meshwork damage; the EAGLE trial supports clear lens extraction as an option.
stages.pitfall: 若無追蹤：慢性隅角閉鎖青光眼無聲進展。
stages.pitfallEn: Unfollowed, chronic angle closure progresses silently.

stages.title: 交班
stages.evidence: 出院給藥單與回診。
stages.evidenceEn: Discharge prescriptions and review.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 只開止痛藥，以後痛再吃就好
choices.en: Analgesics to take if it hurts again

choices.zh: 避免散瞳藥物，復發立即回診
choices.en: Avoid dilating drugs; return at once if recurs

choices.zh: 已雷射治癒，不需特別交代
choices.en: Laser cured it; no special advice

stages.reason: 許多常見藥物（抗組織胺、抗憂鬱、散瞳劑）可誘發；病人需知道自己的風險。
stages.reasonEn: Many common drugs (antihistamines, antidepressants, mydriatics) can precipitate attacks; patients must know their risk.
stages.pitfall: 若未警告：感冒藥引發下一次。
stages.pitfallEn: Unwarned, a cold remedy triggers the next attack.

procedures.title: 化學性眼傷：沖洗優先與 Roper-Hall 分級
procedures.titleEn: Chemical eye injury: irrigation first and Roper-Hall grading
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：31 歲清潔工，工業鹼性清潔劑濺入左眼，同事以礦泉水沖了一下就送來，途中 20 分鐘。本單元教沖洗原則、pH 判斷、分級與預後、轉診時機；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 31-year-old cleaner splashed in the left eye with an industrial alkaline cleaner; a colleague rinsed briefly with bottled water and drove 20 minutes. Teaches irrigation principles, pH checks, grading and prognosis, and referral timing. Education, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 第一動作
stages.evidence: 病人在分流台痛苦捂眼；護理師問要先登記還是先看視力。
stages.evidenceEn: He clutches his eye at the desk; the nurse asks whether to register or test vision first.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 立即大量沖洗，一切檢查延後
choices.en: Irrigate copiously now; everything else waits

choices.zh: 先完成掛號登記再處理
choices.en: Complete the registration first, then treat

choices.zh: 先測視力，作為法律紀錄基準
choices.en: Measure vision first for the legal record

stages.reason: 化學傷是唯一「治療先於檢查」的眼科急症；每一分鐘的鹼都在穿透角膜。
stages.reasonEn: The chemical burn is the one eye emergency where treatment precedes examination; every minute alkali penetrates deeper.
stages.pitfall: 若先登記：角膜在櫃檯前被溶解。
stages.pitfallEn: Registered first, the cornea dissolves at the counter.

stages.title: 沖洗技術
stages.evidence: 你開始沖洗；病人眼瞼緊閉。
stages.evidenceEn: You begin; his lids are clamped shut.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 沖洗一兩分鐘就足以稀釋化學物
choices.en: A minute or two dilutes it enough

choices.zh: 隔著閉起的眼瞼沖洗即可
choices.en: Irrigate over the closed lids

choices.zh: 撐開翻瞼沖穹窿，至少數十分鐘
choices.en: Evert the lids and irrigate the fornices at length

stages.reason: 化學物藏在穹窿；未翻轉上瞼的沖洗是徒勞。任何無菌液體皆可，不要等特定溶液。
stages.reasonEn: Chemical hides in the fornices; irrigation without everting the lid is futile. Any sterile fluid will do; never wait for a specific solution.
stages.pitfall: 若隔著眼瞼：鹼留在穹窿繼續灼傷。
stages.pitfallEn: Over closed lids, alkali stays in the fornix and keeps burning.

stages.title: pH 檢測
stages.evidence: 沖洗 20 分鐘後試紙 pH 10。
stages.evidenceEn: After 20 minutes the strip reads pH 10.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 已沖 20 分鐘，可以停止
choices.en: Twenty minutes is enough; stop

choices.zh: 繼續沖洗，直到 pH 穩定中性
choices.en: Keep irrigating until pH is stably neutral

choices.zh: pH 試紙不準確，看症狀決定即可
choices.en: pH paper is unreliable; go by symptoms

stages.reason: 測量在停沖幾分鐘後進行，否則讀到的是沖洗液；鹼性傷可能需要數公升。
stages.reasonEn: Measure a few minutes after pausing or you read the irrigant; alkali burns may need litres.
stages.pitfall: 若提早停：組織內的鹼回滲，pH 再升。
stages.pitfallEn: Stopped early, alkali leaches back and pH climbs again.

stages.title: 化學物
stages.evidence: 同事帶來瓶子：氫氧化鈉清潔劑。
stages.evidenceEn: The colleague brings the bottle: sodium hydroxide cleaner.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 鹼會穿透前房，預後比酸差
choices.en: Alkali penetrates the chamber; worse than acid

choices.zh: 鹼性比酸性安全，預後較好
choices.en: Alkali is safer than acid

choices.zh: 酸與鹼造成的傷害都相同
choices.en: Acid and alkali cause equal harm

stages.reason: 酸凝固蛋白形成屏障；鹼持續穿透造成虹膜、水晶體與小樑損傷。氫氟酸是例外的危險酸。
stages.reasonEn: Acid coagulates protein into a barrier; alkali keeps penetrating to iris, lens and meshwork. Hydrofluoric acid is the dangerous exception among acids.
stages.pitfall: 若低估鹼：數日後眼壓升高與角膜溶解。
stages.pitfallEn: Alkali underestimated, pressure rises and the cornea melts days later.

stages.title: 分級
stages.evidence: pH 穩定後：上皮全失、基質混濁遮蔽虹膜細節、輪部缺血約 1/3–1/2 周。
stages.evidenceEn: Once pH is stable: total epithelial loss, stromal haze obscuring iris detail, limbal ischaemia of one third to one half.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: Roper-Hall IV：預後非常差
choices.en: Roper-Hall IV: very poor prognosis

choices.zh: Roper-Hall I：預後佳
choices.en: Roper-Hall I: good prognosis

choices.zh: Roper-Hall III：預後保留
choices.en: Roper-Hall III: guarded prognosis

stages.reason: 分級依角膜混濁與輪部缺血：I 無缺血、II <1/3、III 1/3–1/2、IV >1/2（預後極差）。輪部幹細胞決定角膜能否再生。
stages.reasonEn: Grading uses corneal clarity and limbal ischaemia: I none, II under a third, III a third to a half, IV over half with very poor prognosis. Limbal stem cells decide whether the cornea can regenerate.
stages.pitfall: 若未記錄輪部缺血：預後與轉診的急迫性無從判斷。
stages.pitfallEn: Limbal ischaemia unrecorded, prognosis and referral urgency cannot be judged.

stages.title: 清除殘留
stages.evidence: 翻轉上瞼見白色顆粒卡在穹窿。
stages.evidenceEn: Everting the lid reveals white particles in the fornix.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 繼續沖洗顆粒自然會掉
choices.en: Keep irrigating; they'll wash out

choices.zh: 以濕棉棒清除所有顆粒
choices.en: Remove every particle with a damp swab

choices.zh: 顆粒已無活性，不需處理
choices.en: The particles are inert; leave them

stages.reason: 固體化學物是持續的來源；清除是沖洗的一部分。
stages.reasonEn: Solid chemical is an ongoing source; removal is part of irrigation.
stages.pitfall: 若留下顆粒：pH 永遠回不到中性。
stages.pitfallEn: Particles left, pH never normalises.

stages.title: 急性期原則
stages.evidence: 眼科醫師在電話上問你已做什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: The ophthalmologist asks on the phone what has been done.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 已沖洗、pH 穩定並完成分級
choices.en: Irrigated, pH stable and graded

choices.zh: 已給抗生素眼藥水，其餘待眼科
choices.en: Antibiotic drops given; the rest awaits you

choices.zh: 等眼科醫師到再開始處理
choices.en: Waiting for you before starting

stages.reason: 急性期目標：上皮再生、控制發炎、預防感染、監測眼壓；III–IV 級需專科住院評估。
stages.reasonEn: Acute goals: re-epithelialisation, inflammation control, infection prevention and pressure monitoring; grades III-IV need specialist inpatient care.
stages.pitfall: 若資訊不全：眼科重做一切，浪費時間。
stages.pitfallEn: Incomplete information makes ophthalmology start over.

stages.title: 併發症警訊
stages.evidence: 第 7 天：角膜上皮仍未癒合、周邊變薄。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 7: epithelium still unhealed, peripheral thinning.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 加強類固醇點藥來抑制發炎即可
choices.en: Step up steroid drops to suppress inflammation

choices.zh: 化學傷癒合本來就慢，觀察
choices.en: Chemical injuries heal slowly; observe

choices.zh: 缺損加變薄：溶解風險，緊急轉
choices.en: Defect with thinning: melt risk, urgent review

stages.reason: 膠原酶在第 1–3 週活性最高；上皮未癒合的角膜可穿孔。類固醇在此期的使用需專科權衡。
stages.reasonEn: Collagenase peaks in weeks 1-3; an unhealed cornea can perforate. Steroid use at this stage is a specialist judgement.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：角膜穿孔。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, the cornea perforates.

stages.title: 追蹤
stages.evidence: 3 個月：角膜血管翳、瞼球沾黏、乾眼。
stages.evidenceEn: Three months: corneal pannus, symblepharon, dry eye.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 上皮已經癒合，治療已結束
choices.en: The epithelium has healed; treatment is over

choices.zh: 淚液替代並評估輪部幹細胞移植
choices.en: Tear substitutes; assess limbal stem cell grafting

choices.zh: 立即做全層角膜移植以恢復視力
choices.en: Immediate full-thickness corneal graft

stages.reason: 輪部幹細胞缺乏使角膜結膜化；沒有幹細胞重建的角膜移植注定失敗。
stages.reasonEn: Limbal stem cell deficiency conjunctivalises the cornea; a graft without stem cell reconstruction is doomed.
stages.pitfall: 若直接移植：移植片被結膜覆蓋。
stages.pitfallEn: Grafted directly, the graft is overrun by conjunctiva.

stages.title: 交班與預防
stages.evidence: 出院前職安人員來電。
stages.evidenceEn: Occupational safety calls before discharge.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 通報職災，確認沖眼設備
choices.en: Report the injury; check eyewash provision

choices.zh: 給出院摘要讓公司自行處理
choices.en: Give the summary and let the firm handle it

choices.zh: 職安屬公司事務，與醫療無關
choices.en: Workplace safety isn't a medical matter

stages.reason: 現場立即沖洗是預後最強的決定因子；工作場所的沖洗設備救的是下一個人。
stages.reasonEn: Immediate on-site irrigation is the strongest prognostic factor; the eyewash station saves the next worker.
stages.pitfall: 若不通報：下個月同事同樣受傷。
stages.pitfallEn: Unreported, a colleague is injured next month.

procedures.title: 角膜擦傷與角膜異物
procedures.titleEn: Corneal abrasion and corneal foreign body
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：27 歲焊工，未戴護目鏡，右眼異物感與流淚 6 小時。另一位 5 歲男童被樹枝刮到眼睛。本單元教檢查、異物移除的安全原則、鏽環、何時不能在急診處理；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 27-year-old welder without goggles, right eye foreign body sensation and watering for 6 hours. A second patient, a 5-year-old boy scratched by a branch. Teaches examination, safe foreign body removal principles, rust rings and what must not be managed in the ED. Education, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 機轉
stages.evidence: 焊接或敲擊金屬時的高速碎片。
stages.evidenceEn: High-speed fragments from welding or hammering metal.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 症狀很輕微，不需要特別檢查
choices.en: Mild symptoms; no special examination

choices.zh: 碎片很小，一定只在表面
choices.en: Tiny, so it must be superficial

choices.zh: 高速金屬碎片需懷疑眼內異物
choices.en: High-velocity metal: suspect an intraocular body

stages.reason: 敲擊金屬對金屬的碎片可穿透眼球而症狀輕微；機轉決定是否需要影像。
stages.reasonEn: Metal-on-metal fragments can penetrate the globe with minimal symptoms; the mechanism decides whether imaging is needed.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：眼內鐵屑數月後造成鐵質沉著症。
stages.pitfallEn: Missed, intraocular iron causes siderosis months later.

stages.title: 視力與麻醉
stages.evidence: 病人痛到無法張眼。
stages.evidenceEn: He cannot open the eye for pain.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 就算很痛也要先測視力再點麻醉
choices.en: Measure vision before any anaesthetic, despite pain

choices.zh: 點一滴麻醉再測，不讓帶回家
choices.en: One anaesthetic drop, then vision; none to take home

choices.zh: 開麻醉眼藥水讓他帶回家
choices.en: Dispense anaesthetic drops for home

stages.reason: 局部麻醉讓檢查成為可能；重複使用會抑制上皮癒合並掩蓋惡化。
stages.reasonEn: Topical anaesthetic makes examination possible; repeated use impairs healing and masks deterioration.
stages.pitfall: 若給病人帶回：一週後角膜溶解。
stages.pitfallEn: Sent home with it, the cornea melts in a week.

stages.title: 裂隙燈與染色
stages.evidence: 角膜旁中央 1 mm 金屬異物，周圍螢光染色陽性；前房深、無細胞。
stages.evidenceEn: A 1 mm metallic foreign body paracentrally with surrounding fluorescein uptake; deep quiet chamber.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 記錄位置、深度與前房狀態
choices.en: Record position, depth and anterior chamber

choices.zh: 小異物不需記錄，直接處理
choices.en: A small speck needs no notes

choices.zh: 用生理食鹽水直接沖掉
choices.en: Wash it off with saline

stages.reason: 深度（是否達基質）與前房反應決定是急診移除還是轉眼科。
stages.reasonEn: Depth (whether it reaches the stroma) and chamber reaction decide ED removal versus referral.
stages.pitfall: 若未記錄：移除後的瘢痕無從比較。
stages.pitfallEn: Undocumented, a later scar has no reference.

stages.title: 翻轉眼瞼
stages.evidence: 男童：角膜上方多條垂直線狀擦傷。
stages.evidenceEn: The boy: several vertical linear abrasions on the upper cornea.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 給抗生素藥膏，不需翻瞼
choices.en: Antibiotic ointment; no need to evert

choices.zh: 典型樹枝狀刮傷，抗生素即可
choices.en: A typical branch scratch: antibiotics

choices.zh: 垂直線狀擦傷：翻上瞼找異物
choices.en: Vertical scratches: evert the upper lid

stages.reason: 每次眨眼異物刮過角膜留下垂直線；不翻瞼的治療只是等它再刮一次。
stages.reasonEn: Each blink drags the particle across the cornea leaving vertical lines; treating without eversion waits for the next scratch.
stages.pitfall: 若不翻：擦傷永不癒合。
stages.pitfallEn: Unverted, the abrasion never heals.

stages.title: 穿透傷
stages.evidence: 另一位病人：瞳孔淚滴狀、前房淺、Seidel 試驗陽性。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient: teardrop pupil, shallow chamber, positive Seidel test.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 可以在急診直接移除異物再包紮
choices.en: Remove it in the ED, then pad

choices.zh: 開放性眼球傷：硬眼罩並轉診
choices.en: Open globe: rigid shield and refer

choices.zh: 加壓包紮避免房水流失
choices.en: Pressure patch to stop the leak

stages.reason: Seidel 陽性代表房水滲漏；壓迫會擠出眼內容物。
stages.reasonEn: A positive Seidel means aqueous leaking; pressure extrudes intraocular contents.
stages.pitfall: 若加壓：虹膜從傷口脫出。
stages.pitfallEn: Pressed, the iris prolapses through the wound.

stages.title: 異物移除原則
stages.evidence: 焊工的表淺金屬異物；你坐在裂隙燈前。
stages.evidenceEn: The welder's superficial metal fragment; you are at the slit lamp.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 裂隙燈下以針尖切線挑起
choices.en: Lift it tangentially with a needle at the slit lamp

choices.zh: 用濕手指或紗布直接撥除
choices.en: Flick it off with a wet finger or gauze

choices.zh: 用棉棒用力反覆擦拭移除
choices.en: Rub it off hard with a cotton bud

stages.reason: 切線方向避免穿透；棉棒會把異物磨進基質並擴大缺損。深層或視軸中央異物轉眼科。
stages.reasonEn: A tangential approach avoids perforation; a cotton bud grinds the fragment into the stroma and enlarges the defect. Deep or central visual-axis foreign bodies go to ophthalmology.
stages.pitfall: 若用棉棒：缺損變三倍大。
stages.pitfallEn: A cotton bud triples the defect.

stages.title: 鏽環
stages.evidence: 移除後殘留棕色鏽環。
stages.evidenceEn: A brown rust ring remains after removal.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 鏽環會自己慢慢吸收，不需處理
choices.en: The ring will absorb; leave it

choices.zh: 今天就一定要鑽到完全乾淨
choices.en: Drill it completely clean today

choices.zh: 可鑽除；中央或深層留給眼科
choices.en: Burr it; leave central or deep ones to ophthalmology

stages.reason: 鏽環延遲癒合並留疤；但過度鑽挖視軸中央比鏽環本身更傷。
stages.reasonEn: Rust delays healing and scars, yet over-burring the visual axis does more harm than the ring.
stages.pitfall: 若深挖中央：永久視軸疤痕。
stages.pitfallEn: Over-burring the centre leaves a permanent axial scar.

stages.title: 治療與衛教
stages.evidence: 缺損 2 mm，前房安靜。
stages.evidenceEn: A 2 mm defect, quiet chamber.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 眼墊包紮 48 小時促進癒合
choices.en: Patch for 48 hours to aid healing

choices.zh: 局部抗生素，不需眼墊
choices.en: Topical antibiotic; no patch

choices.zh: 類固醇眼藥水減少疼痛
choices.en: Steroid drops to ease pain

stages.reason: 證據顯示眼墊不加速癒合；隱形眼鏡相關擦傷是綠膿桿菌潰瘍的前奏。類固醇延遲癒合。
stages.reasonEn: Evidence shows patching does not speed healing; contact lens abrasions are the prelude to pseudomonal ulcers. Steroids delay healing.
stages.pitfall: 若給隱形眼鏡者一般抗生素：48 小時內潰瘍。
stages.pitfallEn: Standard antibiotics for a lens wearer: an ulcer within 48 hours.

stages.title: 追蹤
stages.evidence: 24 小時複查：焊工缺損縮小一半；男童完全癒合。
stages.evidenceEn: At 24 hours the welder's defect has halved; the boy has healed.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 焊工續追至癒合，男童結案
choices.en: Follow the welder to healing; discharge the boy

choices.zh: 兩人都每天回診追蹤一整週
choices.en: Daily review for both for a week

choices.zh: 兩人都已改善，可以結案
choices.en: Both improving; discharge both

stages.reason: 未如期癒合或出現浸潤即轉眼科；小兒擦傷癒合快。
stages.reasonEn: Failure to heal on schedule or any infiltrate means referral; children heal fast.
stages.pitfall: 若未複查：浸潤變潰瘍。
stages.pitfallEn: Unreviewed, an infiltrate becomes an ulcer.

stages.title: 預防與交班
stages.evidence: 焊工說公司沒有護目鏡。
stages.evidenceEn: The welder says the company provides no goggles.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 眼睛已經好了，不需要處理
choices.en: The eye is fine; nothing to do

choices.zh: 建議他換一份比較安全的工作
choices.en: Advise a safer job

choices.zh: 衛教護目鏡並記錄職災
choices.en: Counsel on goggles and record the injury

stages.reason: 職業性眼傷幾乎都可預防；記錄是改變工作場所的槓桿。
stages.reasonEn: Occupational eye injuries are almost all preventable; documentation is the lever that changes the workplace.
stages.pitfall: 若不記錄：下個月他帶著眼內異物回來。
stages.pitfallEn: Unrecorded, he returns next month with an intraocular foreign body.

procedures.title: 細菌性角膜炎：隱形眼鏡潰瘍的處置
procedures.titleEn: Bacterial keratitis: managing the contact lens ulcer
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：22 歲大學生，戴月拋隱形眼鏡過夜、曾用自來水沖鏡片，左眼劇痛紅腫 2 天，視力 6/36，角膜中央 3 mm 白色浸潤伴前房積膿。本單元教風險因子、刮片培養、經驗性治療原則與類固醇時機，不含藥物劑量；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 22-year-old student who sleeps in monthly lenses and has rinsed them in tap water, severe left eye pain for 2 days, vision 6/36, a 3 mm central white infiltrate with hypopyon. Teaches risk factors, scraping and culture, empirical treatment principles and steroid timing; no doses. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 疱疹性角膜炎：樹枝狀、基質型與類固醇的兩難
procedures.titleEn: Herpetic keratitis: dendritic, stromal and the steroid dilemma
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：39 歲男性，右眼異物感與畏光 3 天，兒時曾有「反覆紅眼」；螢光染色見末端膨大的樹枝狀病灶，角膜知覺減退。本單元教型態辨識、治療原則、類固醇的角色與復發預防，不含藥物劑量；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 39-year-old man with 3 days of right foreign body sensation and photophobia, a childhood history of recurrent red eye; fluorescein shows a dendrite with terminal bulbs and reduced corneal sensation. Teaches pattern recognition, treatment principles, the role of steroids and recurrence prevention; no doses. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 葡萄膜炎：分類、檢查與治療原則
procedures.titleEn: Uveitis: classification, work-up and treatment principles
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲男性，左眼紅痛畏光 4 天，兩年前右眼曾類似發作；有晨間下背僵硬史。本單元教 SUN 分類、前房分級、紅旗、針對性檢查與治療原則，不含藥物劑量；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 29-year-old man with 4 days of left red, painful, photophobic eye, a similar right-eye episode two years ago, and morning low-back stiffness. Teaches SUN classification, anterior chamber grading, red flags, targeted investigation and treatment principles; no doses. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 白內障評估與超音波乳化術：囊袋併發症
procedures.titleEn: Cataract assessment and phacoemulsification: capsular complications
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：74 歲女性，核性白內障雙眼，右眼視力 6/24，夜間開車眩光，服用 tamsulosin（攝護腺用藥由先生誤給）。本單元教術前評估、生物測量與人工水晶體選擇原則、手術安全與後囊破裂的辨識處理，不含手術參數；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 74-year-old woman with bilateral nuclear cataract, right vision 6/24, glare when driving at night, taking tamsulosin (her husband's prostate medication by mistake). Teaches preoperative assessment, biometry and lens choice principles, surgical safety and recognition and management of posterior capsule rupture; no machine settings. Education, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 生物測量與人工水晶體

procedures.title: 後囊混濁與 YAG 雷射後囊切開的概念
procedures.titleEn: Posterior capsule opacification and the concept of YAG capsulotomy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：68 歲男性，白內障術後 2 年視力再度模糊、眩光；裂隙燈見後囊纖維化與 Elschnig 珍珠。本單元教辨識、鑑別其他視力下降原因、雷射的適應症、風險與追蹤，不含雷射參數；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 68-year-old man with blurred vision and glare 2 years after cataract surgery; slit lamp shows posterior capsule fibrosis and Elschnig pearls. Teaches recognition, exclusion of other causes of visual decline, laser indications, risks and follow-up; no laser settings. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 乾眼症與眼瞼炎門診：分型與階梯治療
procedures.titleEn: Dry eye and blepharitis clinic: subtyping and stepped care
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：55 歲女性，雙眼灼熱、異物感、晚上看螢幕後視力波動 1 年，已用五種人工淚液無效；眼瞼緣泡沫狀分泌物與睫毛根部圓柱狀皮屑。本單元教分型（缺水／蒸發）、檢查、階梯治療與紅旗；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 55-year-old woman with a year of bilateral burning, grittiness and fluctuating vision after evening screen use, unhelped by five artificial tears; foamy lid margin secretions and cylindrical dandruff at the lash roots. Teaches subtyping (aqueous-deficient versus evaporative), examination, stepped care and red flags. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 眼內炎：術後、注射後與內因性
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：71 歲男性，白內障術後第 4 天，眼痛加劇、視力從 6/9 降至手動、前房積膿；同時急診另一位靜脈藥癮者發燒伴單眼視力模糊。本單元教辨識、取樣與玻璃體內治療原則、玻璃體切除的時機，不含藥物劑量；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 71-year-old man 4 days after cataract surgery with worsening pain, vision down from 6/9 to hand movements and a hypopyon; in the next cubicle a febrile intravenous drug user with blurred vision in one eye. Teaches recognition, sampling and intravitreal treatment principles, and the timing of vitrectomy; no doses. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 糖尿病視網膜病變篩檢與分級
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：第二型糖尿病 12 年的 58 歲男性，HbA1c 9.5%，兩年未做眼底檢查，視力 6/6 無症狀。眼底攝影見散在微血管瘤、點狀出血與黃斑旁硬性滲出。本單元教篩檢流程、ETDRS／NHS 分級、轉診時效與治療決策的概念；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 58-year-old man with type 2 diabetes for 12 years, HbA1c 9.5%, no eye examination for two years, vision 6/6 and asymptomatic. Fundus photographs show scattered microaneurysms, dot haemorrhages and hard exudates near the macula. Teaches the screening pathway, ETDRS/NHS grading, referral timelines and the concept of treatment decisions. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 糖尿病黃斑水腫：OCT 判讀與抗 VEGF 決策
procedures.titleEn: Diabetic macular oedema: OCT interpretation and anti-VEGF decisions
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：61 歲女性，第二型糖尿病，左眼視力 6/18、看字扭曲；OCT 中心視網膜厚度 420 µm 伴囊樣空腔與視網膜下液。本單元教 OCT 層次判讀、治療選擇（抗 VEGF、類固醇、雷射）、治療方案邏輯與無反應的處理，不含藥物劑量；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 61-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes, left vision 6/18 with distortion; OCT central thickness 420 µm with cystoid spaces and subretinal fluid. Teaches OCT layer interpretation, treatment choice (anti-VEGF, steroid, laser), regimen logic and managing non-response; no doses. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 老年性黃斑部病變：乾性或濕性與抗 VEGF 的時程邏輯
procedures.titleEn: Age-related macular degeneration: dry or wet, and the logic of anti-VEGF scheduling
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：78 歲女性，右眼 3 週來視物變形、中央暗影，左眼多年有隱結與色素變化；右眼視力 6/24，OCT 見視網膜下高反射物質與視網膜下液。本單元教乾濕鑑別、緊急轉診、治療方案邏輯與低視力支持；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 78-year-old woman with 3 weeks of distortion and a central shadow in the right eye, long-standing drusen and pigment change on the left; right vision 6/24, OCT shows subretinal hyperreflective material and fluid. Teaches dry versus wet differentiation, urgent referral, regimen logic and low-vision support. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 視網膜剝離：閃光飛蚊分流與手術選項
procedures.titleEn: Retinal detachment: flashes-and-floaters triage and surgical options
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：52 歲高度近視男性，3 天前突然大量飛蚊與閃光，今早上方視野出現「窗簾」；視力 6/9。本單元教分流、檢查、分類、手術方式的選擇邏輯與術後指導，不含手術參數；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 52-year-old highly myopic man with a sudden shower of floaters and flashes 3 days ago, and this morning a 'curtain' in the upper field; vision 6/9. Teaches triage, examination, classification, the logic of choosing an operation and postoperative instructions; no surgical parameters. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 視網膜靜脈阻塞：缺血型辨識與治療
procedures.titleEn: Retinal vein occlusion: recognising the ischaemic type and treating
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：67 歲男性，高血壓、吸菸，右眼無痛視力模糊 1 週，視力 6/36；眼底四象限火焰狀出血、視盤水腫、棉絮斑。本單元教分型、缺血評估、黃斑水腫治療與新生血管監測，不含藥物劑量；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 67-year-old hypertensive smoker with a week of painless blurring in the right eye, vision 6/36; fundus shows flame haemorrhages in all four quadrants, disc swelling and cotton-wool spots. Teaches typing, ischaemia assessment, treatment of macular oedema and neovascular surveillance; no doses. Education, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 併發症：新生血管性青光眼

procedures.title: 中央視網膜動脈阻塞：眼中風與中風路徑
procedures.titleEn: Central retinal artery occlusion: the eye stroke and the stroke pathway
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：69 歲男性，心房顫動未服抗凝，1 小時前左眼突然無痛完全看不見；視力光感、明顯 RAPD、眼底櫻桃紅斑。本單元教辨識、急性處置的證據、中風路徑啟動與全身評估；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 69-year-old man with untreated atrial fibrillation, sudden painless complete loss of vision in the left eye an hour ago; light perception, dense RAPD, a cherry-red spot. Teaches recognition, the evidence for acute measures, stroke pathway activation and systemic evaluation. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 巨細胞動脈炎：拯救對側眼的急症
procedures.titleEn: Giant cell arteritis: the emergency that saves the other eye
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：76 歲女性，兩週新發顳側頭痛、咀嚼時下頜痠痛、昨天右眼一過性黑矇，今晨右眼視力降至數指；眼底視盤蒼白腫脹。本單元教辨識、檢驗判讀、治療的時間邏輯、顳動脈切片與長期照護，不含藥物劑量；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 76-year-old woman with two weeks of new temporal headache, jaw ache on chewing, transient visual loss in the right eye yesterday and this morning vision down to counting fingers; a pale swollen disc. Teaches recognition, test interpretation, the time logic of treatment, temporal artery biopsy and long-term care; no doses. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 糖尿病眼科團隊交班：病房中的視力風險
procedures.titleEn: Diabetic eye team handover: visual risk on the ward
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：54 歲女性因糖尿病酮酸中毒住院，HbA1c 12%，兩年未做眼底篩檢；準備出院時提到「最近看東西有黑點」。本單元教病房中的眼科風險辨識、快速降糖的眼部風險、結構化轉介與跨團隊交班；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 54-year-old woman admitted with diabetic ketoacidosis, HbA1c 12%, no retinal screening for two years; at discharge planning she mentions 'black spots' in her vision. Teaches ward-level recognition of ophthalmic risk, the ocular risk of rapid glucose lowering, structured referral and cross-team handover. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 視野與 OCT 判讀實驗室
procedures.titleEn: Visual field and OCT interpretation lab
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：判讀室裡有五位病人的 Humphrey 24-2 視野與 OCT：疑似青光眼、腦下垂體腫瘤、視神經炎、黃斑病變與一份不可靠的檢查。本單元教可靠度指標、常見型態、OCT 層次與臨床相關性；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: five patients' Humphrey 24-2 fields and OCTs in the reading room: suspected glaucoma, a pituitary tumour, optic neuritis, macular disease and one unreliable test. Teaches reliability indices, common patterns, OCT layers and clinical correlation. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 原發性開放隅角青光眼：診斷與藥物階梯
procedures.titleEn: Primary open-angle glaucoma: diagnosis and the drops ladder
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：58 歲男性，視光師轉介「眼壓 27 mmHg、杯盤比 0.7」，無症狀，母親因青光眼失明。本單元教完整評估（眼壓、角膜厚度、隅角鏡、視盤、視野、OCT）、目標眼壓與藥物階梯原則，不含劑量；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 58-year-old man referred by his optometrist with IOP 27 mmHg and a cup-disc ratio of 0.7, asymptomatic, mother blind from glaucoma. Teaches full assessment (IOP, corneal thickness, gonioscopy, disc, field, OCT), target pressure and the principles of the drops ladder; no doses. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 青光眼追蹤：進展、SLT 與小樑切除術
procedures.titleEn: Glaucoma follow-up: progression, SLT and trabeculectomy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：66 歲女性，POAG 三種藥物下眼壓仍 24，視野三年進展 MD −4 dB，點藥後眼睛紅痛；兒子陪同問雷射與手術。本單元教進展判斷、SLT 的角色、小樑切除的適應症、同意、術後濾泡照護與併發症辨識，不含參數；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 66-year-old woman with POAG, IOP 24 on three drops, field MD down 4 dB over three years, red sore eyes from the drops; her son asks about laser and surgery. Teaches judging progression, the role of SLT, trabeculectomy indications, consent, bleb care and recognising complications; no settings. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 視盤腫脹：視神經炎或視乳頭水腫
procedures.titleEn: The swollen disc: optic neuritis or papilloedema
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：27 歲女性，右眼 3 天視力下降伴眼球轉動痛、色覺變淡；同日另一位 32 歲肥胖女性頭痛、搏動性耳鳴、短暫視覺模糊，雙眼視盤腫脹但視力 6/6。本單元教兩者的鑑別、檢查、轉診與治療原則；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 27-year-old woman with 3 days of right visual loss, pain on eye movement and washed-out colours; the same day a 32-year-old obese woman with headache, pulsatile tinnitus and transient visual obscurations, bilateral disc swelling and 6/6 vision. Teaches differentiation, investigation, referral and treatment principles. Education, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 視乳頭水腫的影像與腰椎穿刺

procedures.title: 兒童斜視與弱視：篩檢、診斷與治療時機
procedures.titleEn: Childhood strabismus and amblyopia: screening, diagnosis and the treatment window
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：4 歲女童，幼兒園視力篩檢右眼 6/24、左眼 6/6；母親說她偶爾右眼「飄出去」。本單元教兒童視力評估、遮蓋測試、弱視的分類與治療、斜視手術的適應症與時機；教育內容非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 4-year-old girl whose nursery screening found right 6/24, left 6/6; her mother says the right eye sometimes drifts out. Teaches paediatric vision assessment, cover testing, classification and treatment of amblyopia, and the indications and timing of strabismus surgery. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 早產兒視網膜病變篩檢（ICROP）

procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 26-week, 780 g infant in the neonatal unit, now 34 weeks corrected, due for the second screening examination. Teaches screening criteria and timing, ICROP zones and stages, plus disease, treatment thresholds and examination safety; no laser or drug parameters. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 34-year-old man with a stinging left eye after hammering metal; in the ED vision is hand movements, the pupil teardrop-shaped, the chamber shallow. Teaches recognition, what not to do, imaging choice, the Ocular Trauma Score and preoperative preparation; no surgical detail. Education, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 22-year-old man punched in the right eye, with diplopia, periorbital bruising and cheek numbness; an hour later the globe is proptosed and tense and vision has fallen from 6/6 to 6/60. Teaches orbital fracture assessment, recognition of retrobulbar haemorrhage, the concept and timing of lateral canthotomy and cantholysis, and fracture surgery decisions; no step-by-step detail. Education, not a clinical protocol.
